query: I set up an SSH tunnel to my remote MongoDB on localhost:27018 and put the connection string into Compass, but it just spins and never connects — no error message, nothing. The tunnel itself seems fine. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Identifies the missing directConnection=true as the cause: Compass does replica-set discovery, reads the members' internal hostnames, and tries to reach hosts that don't resolve on the local machine
Explains the failure is silent (no clear error), not a tunnel problem
Gives the corrected connection string with directConnection=true and authSource=admin
notes: Guards against the #1 wall: a naive answer blames the tunnel and tells the user to debug SSH, when the real cause is Compass attempting replica-set discovery against unresolvable internal hosts. directConnection=true is the fix and the failure is silent, so there is no error to point at.
